title: General.
officialText:
Gypsum board and gypsum plaster construction shall be of the materials listed in Tables 2506.2 and 2507.2.
These materials shall be assembled and installed in compliance with the appropriate standards listed in Tables 2508.1 and 2511.1,
and Chapter 35.
TABLE 2508.1
INSTALLATION OF GYPSUM CONSTRUCTION
MATERIAL STANDARD
GA-216; ASTM C 840;
Gypsum board
ASTM C 1396
Gypsum sheathing ASTM C 1280
Gypsum board (Interior) ASTM C 36
Gypsum board (Exterior) ASTM C 931
Gypsum veneer base ASTM C 844
Interior lathing and furring ASTM C 841
Steel framing for gypsum boards ASTM C 754; C 1007
